entities.name: Feliks Petančić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Feliks Petančić, known in Latin as Felix Petancius and in Italian as Felice Petanzio, was a Renaissance humanist, historian, scribe and illustrator. A native of Dubrovnik, he worked as a diplomat for both the Republic of Ragusa and the Kingdom of Hungary. His diplomatic travels took him to France, Italy and the Ottoman Empire.
